mechanism: Open on a legible piece of unusual equipment so the viewer asks what it enables, then reveal and lock one performer identity. Prove the capability through a continuous action phrase whose contact, direction changes and completion remain visible. Widen only after the feat so bystander reactions, recording behavior or cleared space act as social proof. End by introducing a second participant or counter-move that transfers the completed demonstration into a fresh challenge. The mechanism is capability-to-witness-to-challenge progression, not a specific skating style or plaza.

invariants.rule: Present the enabling equipment in readable physical contact before revealing the full performer.
invariants.ablation_failure: Starting on a generic portrait removes the mechanical hook.

invariants.rule: Reveal one stable performer and enough public context to establish who will demonstrate and who can witness it.
invariants.ablation_failure: Changing performers or hiding the audience breaks accountability for the feat.

invariants.rule: Show one continuous action phrase with visible contact, direction change and completion.
invariants.purpose: Turns claimed capability into inspectable proof.
invariants.ablation_failure: Montage-only fragments can conceal whether the action was completed.

invariants.rule: Include a spatially connected bystander response after the feat rather than a detached reaction insert.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unrelated reaction faces do not verify the demonstrated event.

invariants.rule: Introduce a second participant or counter-action only after the solo proof is complete.
invariants.purpose: Creates forward momentum without interrupting the evidence.
invariants.ablation_failure: Early competition muddies whose capability was established.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

the source black multi-wheel inline shoes, fastening details and exact cross-step choreography
the source modern waterfront plaza, sunset crowd circle and spectators holding phones
the source exact close-shoe to face reveal to crowd-reaction progression
the source final second female skater entrance, wardrobe, staging and photographic surface
